name: win-drive-root
note: Recorded on Windows (hand-verified first run): h at C:/ stays at C:/, as at / on Linux. Only the header is compared; the rest of the screen lists the machine's C:/ and is blanked.

name: win-backslash-arg
note: Recorded on Windows (hand-verified first run): a path argument with \ separators is shown with /; the screens equal start-in-dir's.

name: win-copy-overwrite
note: Recorded on Windows (hand-verified first run): copying onto an existing file asks overwrite? first (cp -i), and n keeps the file.

name: win-resize-in-prompt
note: Recorded with tui-check record from the Rust build on Linux (OS-independent): the console is resized to 100x30 while the n prompt is open and the screen redraws at the new size.

name: win-cu-copy-overwrite
note: Recorded on Windows with Microsoft Coreutils (hand-verified first run): p runs Coreutils' cp -iRp, which asks its own overwrite question (cp.exe: from the installed layout, cp: from the portable coreutils.exe; normalized to cp:); n keeps dir1/Gamma, cp exits 1, so nnn waits for Enter and shows failed! with the selection kept, as GNU cp does on Linux.

name: win-cu-copy
note: Recorded on Windows with Microsoft Coreutils (hand-verified first run): p copies the selected Gamma into the empty dir2 with cp.exe and clears the selection.

name: win-cu-stat
note: Recorded on Windows with Microsoft Coreutils (hand-verified first run): f shows stat.exe's output in the floating window (no file lines: Coreutils has no file).

name: win-cu-archive
note: Recorded on Windows with Microsoft Coreutils (hand-verified first run): two selected files archived with z, s, relative paths: xargs.exe -0 -a <list> runs Windows' tar.exe -acvf in the directory, which prints 'a beta.md' and 'a Gamma'; g.tar is created and the selection cleared.

name: win-duplicate
note: Recorded on Windows without Git or Coreutils on PATH (hand-verified first run): duplicate copies Gamma to Gamma2 natively.
